title: About
content:
I am Jop. I apparently now write stuff all the time. No really. You'll see.

Public Servant to one government (that you probably know of).

On a current quest to just DO and TRY stuff. To make. To create. To think more. To get better more. To share more. To get off my ass and make changes to me, to my life, and then hopefully, to the world. To put myself out there.
